title: Continued theft of medicines deepens hospital shortages
summary: The Nation reports continuing medicine shortages in Malawi's public hospitals, citing the Health Ministry and Central Medical Stores Trust. Reported causes include diversion of medicines and unpaid supplier debts. Published October 4; no facility-specific severity or exact onset is established.

title: Food insecurity to worsen
summary: The Nation reports warnings of worsening food access in Malawi as prices outpace household incomes, particularly in Central and Southern regions. The article cites a projection of 2.6 million food-insecure people during the 2026/27 consumption period. This is a reported outlook, published October 4, not a county-level emergency assessment.
